description: The Python environments the front-ends run in when the benchmark suite is analyzed. scripts/setup_envs.py creates one per entry, and scripts/evaluate.py picks the environment of each artifact with the rules below. The flow.json front-ends (langflow, flowise) need none.
notes: The benchmarks of a framework share one environment. AutoGen has two, since pyautogen 0.2 (Python 3.12 or older) and autogen-agentchat 0.4+ cannot be installed together, and the benchmarks in case_overrides run under a release of their own.
autogen-5059: AutoGen 0.4.1, whose MagenticOne orchestrator accepts only TextMessage and MultiModalMessage from a participant (0.4.7 also accepts ToolCallSummaryMessage).
autogen-4199: AutoGen 0.4.0.dev6, the release of the issue; its workflow imports autogen_agentchat.task, which 0.4.7 and later lack. It needs Python 3.12 or older.
autogen-6084: AutoGen 0.4.7, the release of the issue, with the web-surfer extra that MultimodalWebSurfer needs.
autogen-6808: AutoGen 0.7.4; the issue's GraphFlow example passes activation_group to DiGraphBuilder.add_edge, which 0.6.1 lacks.
haystack-6433: Haystack 2.0.0b5, the last release before #6729, in which a component without inputs is never scheduled.
haystack-6359, haystack-6431: Haystack 2.0.0b5, which accepts a component instance that already belongs to another pipeline; 2.30.2 refuses it.
langgraph-3950: LangGraph 0.3.18, the release of the issue; up to 0.3.29 a state model passed as Command(update=...) overwrites the fields that were not set.
langgraph-3570: LangGraph 0.3.18; before 0.4.8 a Command.PARENT handoff from a subgraph compiled with checkpointer=True raises ParentCommand.
langgraph-6409: LangGraph 1.0.2, the release of the issue; before 1.0.6 a Command.PARENT handoff out of a subgraph nested two levels deep in checkpointed graphs raises ParentCommand.
The C# benchmarks (entry Workflow.csproj:...) need no Python environment: scripts/setup_envs.py dotnet publishes the .NET front-end and builds each project under the release it pins.
